tools.name: run_daily_reminder_batch_job
tools.description: Runs the clinic's reminder batch script for a given date, which processes that day's scheduled appointments through the reminder pipeline.

params.name: appointment_date
params.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format for which to run the reminder job

params.name: clinic_location_code
params.description: Code of the clinic location to process

tools.code:
import subprocess
import re
from pathlib import Path

REMINDER_SCRIPT_PATH = Path("/opt/clinic/scripts/send_reminders.py")


def run_daily_reminder_batch_job(appointment_date: str, clinic_location_code: str) -> dict:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", appointment_date):
        raise ValueError("appointment_date must be formatted as YYYY-MM-DD")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9_-]{2,16}", clinic_location_code):
        raise ValueError("clinic_location_code has an invalid format")

    command_arguments_list = [
        "python3",
        "-I",
        str(REMINDER_SCRIPT_PATH),
        "--date",
        appointment_date,
        "--location",
        clinic_location_code,
    ]
    completed_process_result = subprocess.run(
        command_arguments_list,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=600,
        check=False,
    )
    captured_standard_output_text = completed_process_result.stdout.strip()
    captured_standard_error_text = completed_process_result.stderr.strip()

    return {
        "exit_code": completed_process_result.returncode,
        "succeeded": completed_process_result.returncode == 0,
        "stdout_tail": captured_standard_output_text[-2000:],
        "stderr_tail": captured_standard_error_text[-2000:],
    }

tools.name: cancel_appointment_and_notify_patient
tools.description: Cancels an appointment by deleting it from the schedule and emails the patient a cancellation notice.

params.name: appointment_id
params.description: ID of the appointment to cancel

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def cancel_appointment_and_notify_patient(appointment_id: int) -> str:
    db = sqlite3.connect("clinic.db")
    row = db.execute(
        "SELECT p.email, a.starts_at FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON p.id = a.patient_id WHERE a.id = ?",
        (appointment_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        db.close()
        return "Appointment not found"
    db.execute("DELETE FROM appointments WHERE id = ?", (appointment_id,))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "noreply@clinic.example.com"
    msg["To"] = row[0]
    msg["Subject"] = "Your appointment has been cancelled"
    msg.set_content(f"Your appointment on {row[1]} has been cancelled.")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.clinic.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    return f"Cancelled appointment {appointment_id} and notified {row[0]}"

tools.name: grant_staff_schedule_access
tools.description: Gives a staff member a role on a provider's appointment schedule, such as viewer or editor, replacing any role they already hold there.

params.name: staff_user_id
params.description: ID of the staff member receiving access

params.name: provider_id
params.description: ID of the provider whose schedule is shared

params.name: role
params.description: Role to assign: viewer, editor, or manager

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def grant_staff_schedule_access(staff_user_id: int, provider_id: int, role: str) -> str:
    if role not in ("viewer", "editor", "manager"):
        return "Invalid role"
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("clinic.db")) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO schedule_permissions (staff_user_id, provider_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, ?) "
                "ON CONFLICT(staff_user_id, provider_id) DO UPDATE SET role = excluded.role",
                (staff_user_id, provider_id, role),
            )
    return f"Staff {staff_user_id} now has {role} access to provider {provider_id}"
